Name: Guided Rounds v1.9.12
Description: 把 P-92 法令手枪的原版制导移植到武器清单里的每一把枪上：弹丸出膛后自动追踪敌人，伤害和初速保持武器原本的数值。带索敌范围圆环、目标锁定标记与方框，全部参数可在游戏内 MODS 菜单实时调整。需要 Bingus Shared Loader v15+ 与 HD2Runtime。v1.8.1 是代码健壮性与可读性优化（玩法与 v1.8.0 一致，另修掉四处会报错的隐患）；v1.8.2 修掉锁定目标方框在切换武器后残留的问题。v1.9.0 枪械按类型分页、瞄准优先级按阵营分页，并移除无敌的认知干扰器本体。v1.9.11 修好单枪优先级按手上的枪取表、自定义未指向该枪、换枪后模式滞后，以及 0 视作未设置。v1.9.12 修好个别光能族（尤其无票者）锁不上：死亡缓存不再被部件状态写成、缺姿态骨骼时退回该资源上次见到的姿态、零坐标骨骼视为读不到，WATCH 日志新增 dead= 与 status= 计数。v1.9.12 修好个别光能族（尤其无票者）锁不上：死亡缓存不再被部件状态写成、缺姿态骨骼时退回该资源上次见到的姿态、零坐标骨骼视为读不到，WATCH 日志新增 dead= 与 status= 计数。  |  Guided rounds ported from the P-92 Warrant to every weapon on the list, with an aim-cone range ring, a lock marker and a target box, all tunable from the in-game MODS tab. Requires Bingus Shared Loader v15+ and HD2Runtime. v1.8.1 is a robustness and readability pass (gameplay unchanged from v1.8.0, plus four latent crash fixes); v1.8.2 fixes the lock target box that stayed on screen after a weapon switch. v1.9.0 groups weapons by class and splits manual priority by faction. v1.9.11 fixes per-weapon priority reading the weapon in hand, CUSTOM not arming that weapon's table, a stale mode after a weapon switch, and 0 meaning unset. v1.9.12 fixes Illuminate units (Voteless most of all) that could not be locked: only status=2 (the game's real death mark) condemns a unit: an Illuminate Voteless's draining constitution record sits at status=1 while the body is alive and used to lock that body out for 60 s; all-zero bones now read as unreadable, and the WATCH debug line counts dead= and status= drops. v1.9.12 fixes Illuminate units (Voteless most of all) that could not be locked: only status=2 (the game's real death mark) condemns a unit: an Illuminate Voteless's draining constitution record sits at status=1 while the body is alive and used to lock that body out for 60 s; all-zero bones now read as unreadable, and the WATCH debug line counts dead= and status= drops.
